verdict.rationale: The documented transaction endpoint creates a transaction and runs payment screening and transaction monitoring. Nothing in the evidence shows it returns a machine-learning risk score, or that it runs synchronously before authorization completes. The documented synchronous mode and the configurable risk-score equation apply to customer screening and onboarding, not transactions, so they are adjacent capabilities and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a machine-learning risk score for a transaction in real time — synchronously, before authorization completes — through a documented API
